description: An ancient-Greek galley on the water: a flared plank hull with a dark waterline wale, a low ram (embolos) and rising stempost at the prow, a curled aphlaston at the stern, oar rows rendered with spruce trapdoors and button oar-ports, a single mast carrying a white-wool square sail, and the apotropaic eye (ophthalmos) painted on both bows. The showcase set-piece of the nobodys-cave-island remake, moored offshore and visible from spawn.

tags.era_style: ancient Greek / Aegean bronze age, vanilla carpentry

style_fit.rationale: The escape-promise centerpiece for the nobodys-cave-island remake: a purpose-built Greek galley (ram + oar rows + single square sail + ophthalmos eye) rather than a generic age-of-sail ship, so it reads to the era of the Odyssey source material. Standalone set-piece (zero connectors, one anchor/deck) placed offshore by anchor offset — the robust hero-galleon-oak pattern. Renders clean at 1.21.11; iterated on the render loop until the galley silhouette is unmistakable.
